architecture: Raw unpadded waveform through pinned phonetic wav2vec2; unchanged expected CTC context windows pool final1024 states; append fixed13 scalars; fixed fit-target-row1037 moments; existing phone-conditioned mean head on singleton rows.
encoderMode: eval throughout, float32 eager attention, no SpecAugment/layerdrop/backbone dropout. Only encoder.layers.23 may update; final encoder layer norm and all lower/feature-extractor parameters remain frozen.
execution: Local CPU or serial MPS only; shared adaptation-mps.lock must be free. Actual MPS preflight and real fits require root review and independent review. No paid resources.
limitations: CTC windows are unvalidated expected-position estimates, not observed produced-phone intervals.
Existing five-rater labels describe this corpus; no child-SSD correctness decision or ages2to5 evidence.
Inner selection and reused overlapping splits are exploratory; no independent generalization or clinical claim.
Upper-layer benefit is compared with matched raw head-only continuation; epoch-zero device differences are reported separately.
Runtime and MPS memory require actual preflight; CPU frozen extraction is not a reliable training-time forecast.
normalization: Exactly the warm head fit-only target-row mean/population SD from frozen1024+13 values; held fixed while encoder changes.
numerics: Raw pooling uses float32 because MPS lacks float64; frozen vectors used float64 accumulation then float32 storage. Before any update retain raw epoch-zero predictions and maximum difference vs original cached CPU predictions; reject max probability difference above0.001.
objective: Mean natural-log loss against five-rater count/5 distribution, every target row equally weighted within each accumulated four-clip group; no class weighting or CTC objective.
resumability: Atomic last checkpoint only at completed optimizer boundaries saves upper tensors/head, fixed moments, optimizer, CPU/MPS/Python/NumPy RNG, epoch permutation/cursor/loss counters and selected immutable checkpoint checksum. An unfinished update is rerun from the last persisted boundary.
selection: Epoch zero is an eligible immutable raw-audio checkpoint. Each regime selects by its declared all-age or ages6to12 macro-phone NLL. Improvement must exceed1e-7, otherwise earlier epoch wins. Across arms exact ties prefer no encoder change then lower backbone LR.
sourceBinding: All new and reused source hashes are fixed in config.json before real fitting; launch runner must pin reviewed trainer and recipe.
